title: Data Analysis Foundations: SQL Thinking & Python Analytics
concept: Answer business questions with data: filtering and aggregating with SQL, joins without double counting, window functions for trends and cohorts, then summarizing and checking results in Python. Queries run on SQLite.
description: A beginner course for anyone who has to answer business questions with data and wants the numbers to be right. Every lesson starts from a wrong number in a real report at Beanbox, a small online coffee shop - a coupon count inflated by AND/OR precedence, "customers" that are really orders, a filter that drops every NULL, a March missing its last day, revenue double counted by a join, a retention rate divided by the wrong denominator - and fixes it in SQL on SQLite: filtering and aggregating, NULL logic, dates and CASE, joins without double counting, CTEs, window functions and cohort tables, then checking every result from Python before it is sent. 9 lessons with hands-on SQL challenges.
